title: erophila vulgaris var. hirtella
intro: Erophila vulgaris var. hirtella, commonly known as Erophila, is a plant species in the family Brassicaceae. It is known for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine for various health benefits. The plant has been found to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents of Erophila include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
